summary:
This game is called, Skyhauler, its a game where you fight space like creatures and different kinds of them, such as, bugs,aliens, and even ROBOTS!  
select your pilot, every pilot has a abillity, not all of them have the same abillity, choose your own spaceship, all space ships have different abillities!


CONQUER PLANETS!  KILLS EVIL CREATURES! EXPLORE! UPGRADE! DISCOVER!
details:
Skyhauler can be played with a keyboard alone, no need for anything else, mouse is helpful though!
Skyhauler makes the player not get bored and have infinite amount of exploration and action!
i used alot of python and java script and a little of codex!
Skyhauler is creative since it makes the player not want to stop playing, which most games fail to do!
I made SkyHauler by myself, due to me not having a good team/no team at all.
